title: AXOM Disease & Pathology Atlas Build 005 — recovery checkpoint

unresolved.original_photo_download: Original pathology files not accessible in document environment; HTML galleries link to original online images

profile_summaries.name: Autoimmune hepatitis
profile_summaries.mechanism: immune interface hepatitis with plasma cells
profile_summaries.recognition: biopsy/IgG/autoantibodies and exclusion of mimics
profile_summaries.management: corticosteroids with azathioprine or mycophenolate per individualized specialist approach

profile_summaries.name: Primary biliary cholangitis (PBC)
profile_summaries.mechanism: autoimmune small intrahepatic bile duct destruction
profile_summaries.recognition: persistent ALP-predominant cholestasis, AMA or PBC-specific ANA
profile_summaries.management: UDCA first-line; seladelpar permitted in selected jurisdictions; obeticholic acid withdrawn U.S. 2025

profile_summaries.name: Primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC)
profile_summaries.recognition: MRCP multifocal strictures; exclude secondary disease
profile_summaries.management: endoscopic management of significant obstruction, complications, surveillance; transplant selected end-stage cases

profile_summaries.name: Wilson disease, hepatic phenotype
profile_summaries.recognition: 24-hour urine copper, ceruloplasmin, ocular/genetic/biopsy clues combined
profile_summaries.management: chelation or zinc with specialized lifelong monitoring; transplant for acute liver failure

profile_summaries.name: HFE-related hereditary hemochromatosis
profile_summaries.recognition: transferrin saturation, ferritin, HFE genotype; stage fibrosis
profile_summaries.management: therapeutic phlebotomy with iron monitoring

profile_summaries.name: Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency–associated liver disease
profile_summaries.mechanism: misfolded A1AT protein retention in hepatocytes
profile_summaries.recognition: PAS-D positive globules, low serum A1AT with phenotype/genotype
profile_summaries.management: manage complications; transplantation for advanced hepatic disease

profile_summaries.name: Budd–Chiari syndrome
profile_summaries.recognition: Doppler/CT/MRI and thrombophilia evaluation
profile_summaries.management: anticoagulation and graded decompression/TIPS/transplant indications

profile_summaries.name: Portal vein thrombosis, nonmalignant
profile_summaries.mechanism: portal inflow thrombosis with varied acuity
profile_summaries.recognition: Doppler/contrast imaging classify recent vs chronic, percent obstruction
profile_summaries.management: individualize anticoagulation, especially recent substantial clot, and treat portal hypertension

profile_summaries.name: Pyogenic liver abscess
profile_summaries.recognition: imaging, cultures, source control
profile_summaries.management: culture-directed antibiotics plus drainage where indicated

profile_summaries.name: Hepatic cystic echinococcosis
profile_summaries.mechanism: Echinococcus granulosus cyst with laminated layer
profile_summaries.recognition: WHO imaging stage CE1–CE5, exposure/serology
profile_summaries.management: stage/size-dependent observation, albendazole, PAIR, surgery under specialist care

profile_summaries.name: Hepatocellular adenoma
profile_summaries.mechanism: benign hepatocellular tumour with bleeding/transformation risk
profile_summaries.recognition: MRI characteristics, size and molecular subtype
profile_summaries.management: stop risk hormones, manage size and sex-specific resection indications

profile_summaries.name: Focal nodular hyperplasia (FNH)
profile_summaries.mechanism: hyperplastic hepatocyte lesion with anomalous arteries
profile_summaries.recognition: MRI hepatobiliary contrast, central scar; distinguish adenoma
profile_summaries.management: usually no therapy when confidently diagnosed

profile_summaries.name: Cavernous hemangioma of the liver
profile_summaries.recognition: typical discontinuous peripheral nodular imaging enhancement
profile_summaries.management: reassurance/observation unless symptomatic complicated

profile_summaries.name: Biliary atresia
profile_summaries.mechanism: progressive obliteration of neonatal extrahepatic ducts
profile_summaries.recognition: conjugated jaundice with acholic stool; urgent cholangiography evaluation
profile_summaries.management: early Kasai portoenterostomy with transplant if progression

profile_summaries.name: Choledocholithiasis
profile_summaries.recognition: bilirubin/ALP, US and EUS/MRCP/ERCP risk stratification
profile_summaries.management: ERCP for confirmed obstruction/cholangitis, cholecystectomy when appropriate

profile_summaries.name: Acute ascending cholangitis
profile_summaries.recognition: Charcot features may be incomplete; inflammatory/cholestatic tests and obstruction imaging
profile_summaries.management: antibiotics + urgent/early biliary drainage adjusted to severity

profile_summaries.name: IgG4-related sclerosing cholangitis
profile_summaries.recognition: serum IgG4 not diagnostic alone; imaging, histology, exclude cholangiocarcinoma
profile_summaries.management: glucocorticoids or steroid-sparing therapy after excluding malignancy

profile_summaries.name: Type 1 autoimmune pancreatitis
profile_summaries.recognition: sausage-like pancreas, duct changes, IgG4/other-organ involvement
profile_summaries.management: steroids when indicated after exclusion of pancreatic cancer

profile_summaries.name: Intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm (IPMN)
profile_summaries.recognition: main duct vs branch duct and mural nodule risk
profile_summaries.management: surveillance or surgery per Kyoto 2024 high-risk features

profile_summaries.name: Pancreatic mucinous cystic neoplasm (MCN)
profile_summaries.mechanism: mucinous epithelial lining plus ovarian-type stroma
profile_summaries.recognition: usually body/tail in women, lacks ductal communication
profile_summaries.management: surgical evaluation according to size, symptoms, malignancy risk

profile_summaries.name: Pancreatic serous cystadenoma
profile_summaries.recognition: honeycomb microcysts, stellate scar, low malignant risk
profile_summaries.management: no intervention when asymptomatic and secure diagnosis

profile_summaries.name: Pancreatic pseudocyst after pancreatitis
profile_summaries.mechanism: mature inflammatory-walled pancreatic fluid collection without epithelium
profile_summaries.recognition: post-pancreatitis interval and absence of necrotic debris
profile_summaries.management: observe uncomplicated; endoscopic or other drainage for symptomatic/infected collections
